title: Emendable
summary: EMEND'ABLE, adjective [Latin emendabilis, from emendo, to correct; e and menda, a spot or blemish.] Capable of being amended or corrected. [See Amendable.]

inlines.v: EMEND'ABLE, adjective [Latin emendabilis, from emendo, to correct; e and menda, a spot or blemish.] Capable of being amended or corrected. [See Amendable.]
